issues.problem: Slide 7 teaches the name badge as a 'forever' loop scrolling show string, but the canonical MakeCode solution runs show string once inside 'on start' since a forever loop re-scrolls the name endlessly.
issues.fix: Show the canonical 'on start' + show string structure (or explicitly justify the forever choice) so learners meet a correct, non-repeating name-badge pattern.

issues.problem: The Evaluate slide asks reflective questions but embeds no lightweight formative check, and provenance records assessment as missing for L1-s1.
issues.fix: Add an under-two-minute demo/exit-ticket check (e.g. 'point to the block that scrolls your name') into the Evaluate slot.

issues.problem: Only an open Extend phase is offered; there is no support tier (starter code, step-by-step scaffold, tiered objectives) and provenance records differentiation as missing.
issues.fix: Add a paired support option such as micro:bit Classroom starter code or the step-by-step tutorial alongside the existing stretch, per low-floor/high-ceiling design.

issues.problem: The lesson defines no visible success criteria or answer-key convention, so teachers cannot judge whether a learner's name badge is correct beyond it 'working'.
issues.fix: State an observable success criterion (correct name text in show string, block attached to a valid handler, scrolls on the LED display) for the Evaluate/Share check.

issues.problem: The Evaluate slide stacks five reflective questions at once, raising extraneous cognitive load for a young-kids first session.
issues.fix: Reduce to one focused prompt per Evaluate moment (one idea per slide) and defer the rest to teacher notes.

issues.problem: The session opens directly on screen/recap talk with no unplugged kinesthetic priming before coding, which best practice recommends for the youngest track.
issues.fix: Add a brief screen-free hook (e.g. act out an 'algorithm' of instructions) before introducing MakeCode.
